actions.name: convert_to_pdf
actions.title: Convert to PDF
actions.help: This action converts a source document to a PDF file. Supported source formats: Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), CSV, Image (.png / .jpg), HTML. Maximum input file size: 100 MB.

actions.name: extract_text
actions.title: Extract text from PDF
actions.description: Extract text from a PDF document
actions.help: This action extracts text content from digital (machine-readable) PDF documents, returning structured per-page text. Example PDFs supported: PDFs created from Word, Excel, PowerPoint, web pages, or system-generated reports. Scanned or image-based PDFs are not supported.

actions.name: merge_pdf
actions.title: Merge PDF
actions.description: Merge multiple PDFs into a single document
actions.help: This action merges multiple PDF files into a single PDF document, in the order provided. Minimum 2 files, maximum 50. Total size of all files must be under 100 MB.

actions.name: split_pdf
actions.title: Split PDF
actions.description: Split a PDF into multiple files
actions.help: This action splits a PDF document into multiple smaller files. You can split by specifying exact page ranges or by setting a fixed interval. Maximum 50 output files.

actions.name: stamp_pdf
actions.title: Stamp PDF
actions.description: Stamp text or images to PDF
actions.help: This action adds text or image stamps onto PDF pages as overlays while preserving original content. Note: Stamping signed-PDFs will automatically invalidate signatures in the output file. For workflows requiring valid signatures, apply stamps before signing.
